title: Spoke return (spoke -> coordinator)
description: Every spoke's final message must be exactly one fenced ```json code block conforming to this schema, and nothing else outside the fence. The coordinator validates every return against this schema (via the jsonschema package, already a project dependency) before acting on it -- a return that fails validation is itself a failure (failure_type: malformed-return), not something to interpret charitably.

summary.description: One paragraph: what was actually produced. Never claim success with an empty or stubbed deliverable.

tests_run.description: Every test command actually executed, with its real result. Empty array means no tests were run -- that is itself meaningful and should be rare for a TDD task.

contract_gaps.description: Places the brief's contract was insufficient for what was actually needed. Empty array (not omitted) if none -- distinguish 'checked, no gaps' from not having checked.

attempted.description: Concretely what was tried, including exact commands run.

alternatives.description: What to try next, or what the coordinator should change about the brief.
